title: MZ Custom Player Character Creation... HELP!

posts.author: rainbowgems
posts.body:
I'm building a fantasy mystery, so a core aspect of the game is the player getting to be whatever fantasy species they want to be. I originally just intended to draw every possible species/skin/eye/hair/horn/wing/tail combination myself and code it with conditional branches, switches and player image changes. Unfortunately, that's 112,896 possible combinations and far too many switches for me to keep track of.
If I want to preserve the character creation part of my game, I need an easier way for the player to build their sprite. Does anyone have a way where I can just draw the traits separate and have them layered together once selected? I'm not using typical RPG sprites for this game, so I need a plugin that allows me to put my own sprite and colors in the databank.
SumRndmDudes Character Creator plugin is unreliable; it doesn't work for me. None of the others that I have found seem to work either.
...Help?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Welcome!
rainbowgems said:
SumRndmDudes Character Creator plugin is unreliable; it doesn't work for me. None of the others that I have found seem to work either.
Click to expand...
This part of your post is unhelpful.
When you don't list which plugins "none of the others" are, you're just going to get duplicate suggestions.
Additionally, code does what it does. If you're using an MZ plugin according to its instructions, it should work. If you're trying multiple plugins and none of them seem to work, it is pretty guaranteed to be a problem on your end - there's no way multiple people have made plugins for this and they're all broken.
So you need to be choosing one of these plugins to use, telling us which one it is, and then saying exactly
how
it doesn't work for you.

posts.body:
The thing is I'm not actually looking for suggestions, I'm looking for someone who can make the plugin I need. Perhaps I overlooked something, but I searched for this topic before making this thread and found SergioV7's thread. "None of the others" are the suggestions listed there: ie. Mokusei Penguin and Pheonix KageDesu.
Assuming the Jupiter Penguin on woodpenguin.web and Mokusei Penguin are the same person, because I could not find a character creator from Mokusei Penguin on google. Jupiter Penguin's character creator seems like a "choose your character" rather than a "build your character" judging by the screenshots.
The link to Pheonix KageDesu took me to an animated character plugin, which I don't need. I need a character creator.
SumRndmDudes is really big; like, REALLY BIG. I don't need that many bells and whistles. I don't want outfits or mouths or combat sprite options. I just want species/skin/eye/hair/horn/wing/tail. Also, as far as I can see, there is no way to replace SumRndmDudes's sprites with my own, but again, I may have missed something.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
rainbowgems said:
SergioV7's thread...Jupiter Penguin's character creator...The link to Pheonix KageDesu
Click to expand...
Just as specifying which plugins you've tried and how they don't work will help others to help you, so will providing links to what you're talking about. You're kind of presuming that people will not only want to help, but also take the time to look for the threads and plugins you're talking about
rainbowgems said:
SumRndmDudes is really big; like, REALLY BIG. I don't need that many bells and whistles. I don't want outfits or mouths or combat sprite options.
Click to expand...
Then you don't use them. Having options you don't take advantage of doesn't hurt your project in any way, so long as what you
do
use does what you want.
rainbowgems said:
Also, as far as I can see, there is no way to replace SumRndmDudes's sprites with my own, but again, I may have missed something.
Click to expand...
Of course you can. The plugin doesn't care what images are in the folders, the instructions only tell you how to create the required folder structure. The only images referred to in the instructions are for backgrounds and default templates.
However, you say you're using MZ and I don't see an SRD Character Creator plugin for MZ. Both the original Character Creator and the EX are for RPG Maker MV, and since they use their own windows and scenes, I wouldn't think the plugin is compatible with MZ at all.
rainbowgems said:
The thing is I'm not actually looking for suggestions, I'm looking for someone who can make the plugin I need.
Click to expand...
As
@Eliaquim
says, this is not a simple thing to make - it requires knowledge of how RPG Maker loads files, how Pixi can manipulate graphics, and how to construct windows and scenes in the engine. Even with that knowledge, it takes notable time and effort to write the code for this - you're very unlikely to get someone offering to do it for you for free.
So it makes the most sense to try to help you figure out how to use an existing plugin in a way that works for what you want, which is why we're trying to figure exactly what you
do
want, what you've tried, and why those options don't work for you.

Mokusei can mean wooden or Jupiter,  although Jupiter is a wrong translation in this case as the site uses the characters for wooden. It's what happens when you rely on online auto translation. The dev's name as signed in the copyright on the site and in the site's plugin files is Mokusei Penguin.
PKD's plugin is a bit overkill but it does do dynamic paper doll layering of the map sprite so you can play dress up with it.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
rainbowgems said:
The thing is I'm not actually looking for suggestions, I'm looking for someone who can make the plugin I need.
Click to expand...
The problem with that idea is that the more complex plugins take months or years to develop, and people will not do that for free unless they need them for their own games.
So if some similar plugins already exist, most programmers will not work on additional plugin variants unless they are being paid for that.
so your best shot imho would be to try to make SRD's plugin work. We can help with that if you want

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
rainbowgems said:
I've had too many experiences where I download to test and end up getting something on my computer that subsequently causes it to breakdown. I'm working with a very old and temperamental computer, so I have to be extremely cautious picky with what I download because I can't afford to get another one.
Click to expand...
There's no way a plugin in your project could accidentally affect anything else on your computer.
It would have to intentionally contain malicious code that did something to your system files or something, and that would be blatantly obvious from people reporting issues with it and no one recommending it (and there's just no reason for anyone to do it in the first place).
It basically can't possibly harm your computer to try out a plugin.
